source_audit.section: Proof of Theorem 1.2: boundary trimming and cell-mean projection
source_audit.scope: Use the source strategy, but prove an explicit error formula for actual centered functions. If a fraction theta of cells is deleted and the original normalized cell error is delta, squared-integral centering error is at most ((delta+theta*(1+delta))^2+theta)*M^2. The theta term explicitly charges deleted cells. This supplies a needed proof obligation; it is not a claim that the published theorem is false or a novelty claim.

formal_checkpoint: R1759 recorded; never rerun checkpoint script
proof_scope: In progress. R1759 discharges cell trimming and its actual squared-integral projection error. GridTrimming proves exact occupied mass sums for selected cells, the complementary mass partition, the changed occupancy of each retained/deleted cell, and a loss bound theta*(1+delta)*M from original normalized cell error delta. Removing the first and last m cells deletes exactly 2m cells and leaves a subset of [m/K,1-m/K], for 2m<=K. GridProjectionError constructs actual real step functions, proves their integrability and exact squared-integral formula, and proves the cell-centered indicator has zero integral on every cell. The difference between globally centered and cell-centered indicators equals a step function almost everywhere, with an integrable square. After trimming, its squared integral is at most ((delta+theta*(1+delta))^2+theta)*M^2, where theta is the removed-cell fraction. The final theta term explicitly charges zeroed cells. Source-family corollaries substitute delta=K*(K-1)*sigma and theta=2m/K. This is a proved error budget toward the analytic expansion theorem, not that theorem itself.

The zero integral on every cell and the actual squared-integral error are already proved in GridProjectionError. Use the explicit delta/theta error budget to obtain a concrete small relative projection error; do not drop its theta term. Then prove sufficiently near-identity rational Mobius maps and their inverses preserve the trimmed central support and establish the almost-invariance estimates needed for the restricted spectral-gap reduction. The spectral gap and rational-generator existence must still be proved from library results or complete proofs, never new axioms or numerical tests. Preserve all six targets; after full 201/202 complete nonsingular affine-motion 200/210 and regular recursion 206/208, then run authorized impartial referees.
